# freeunitconvert.app — Full Documentation

## Overview
freeunitconvert.app is a free, open, client-side unit converter web application. It converts units across eight categories instantly in the browser with no server calls, no ads, no tracking, and no sign-up. It works offline as a progressive web app.

## URL
https://freeunitconvert.app/

## Categories and Units

### Length (base unit: Meter)
| Unit | Factor (to meters) |
|------|-------------------|
| Kilometer | 1000 |
| Meter | 1 |
| Centimeter | 0.01 |
| Millimeter | 0.001 |
| Micrometer | 1e-6 |
| Nanometer | 1e-9 |
| Mile | 1609.344 |
| Yard | 0.9144 |
| Foot | 0.3048 |
| Inch | 0.0254 |
| Nautical Mile | 1852 |

### Weight (base unit: Kilogram)
| Unit | Factor (to kilograms) |
|------|----------------------|

| Gram | 0.001 |
| Milligram | 1e-6 |
| Metric Ton | 1000 |
| Pound | 0.45359237 |
| Ounce | 0.028349523125 |
| Stone | 6.35029318 |
| US Ton | 907.18474 |
| Imperial Ton | 1016.0469088 |

### Temperature (special formulas)
- Celsius to Fahrenheit: F = C × 9/5 + 32
- Fahrenheit to Celsius: C = (F − 32) × 5/9
- Celsius to Kelvin: K = C + 273.15
- Kelvin to Celsius: C = K − 273.15
- Fahrenheit to Kelvin: K = (F − 32) × 5/9 + 273.15
- Kelvin to Fahrenheit: F = (K − 273.15) × 9/5 + 32

## Conversion Method
All conversions (except temperature) work by converting the input value to the base unit, then from the base unit to the target unit:
  result = input_value × (from_unit_factor / to_unit_factor)

Temperature uses direct formulas listed above.

## Popular Conversion Pages

### Kilograms to Pounds
- URL: https://freeunitconvert.app/kg-to-lbs.html
- Formula: kg × 2.20462 = lbs
- Key fact: 1 kg = exactly 2.20462262185 lbs
- Common use: travel luggage limits, fitness, cooking, shipping

### Celsius to Fahrenheit
- URL: https://freeunitconvert.app/celsius-to-fahrenheit.html
- Formula: °C × 9/5 + 32 = °F
- Key facts: 0°C = 32°F, 100°C = 212°F, 37°C = 98.6°F, -40°C = -40°F
- Common use: weather, cooking, medical temperature, science

### Miles to Kilometers
- URL: https://freeunitconvert.app/miles-to-km.html
- Formula: miles × 1.60934 = km
- Key fact: 1 mile = exactly 1.609344 km
- Common use: running (marathon = 42.195 km), driving, travel

### Inches to Centimeters
- URL: https://freeunitconvert.app/inches-to-cm.html
- Formula: inches × 2.54 = cm (exact)
- Key fact: 1 inch = exactly 25.4 mm by international definition since 1959
- Common use: screen sizes, height, construction, clothing

### Pounds to Kilograms
- URL: https://freeunitconvert.app/lbs-to-kg.html
- Formula: lbs × 0.453592 = kg
- Key fact: 1 lb = exactly 0.45359237 kg
- Common use: international travel, medical records, Olympic sports

## Features
- Instant conversion as you type (no submit button needed)
- Copy result to clipboard with one click
- Swap units button to reverse conversion direction
- Conversion formula and quick reference table for every unit pair
- Dark mode with preference saved to localStorage
- Last-used category and units restored on reload
- Works offline (progressive web app with service worker)
- Fully responsive — desktop, tablet, and mobile
- No tracking, no cookies, no server-side processing
- No ads, no sign-up, completely free

## Accuracy
- IEEE 754 double-precision floating-point arithmetic
- All factors from internationally recognized definitions (NIST, SI)
- Results display up to 10 significant digits, no trailing zeros
- Automatic scientific notation for very large or very small values
- Temperature uses exact formulas, not rounded multipliers

## Technical Details
- Single-page application: HTML + CSS + JavaScript, no framework
- Service worker: cache-first strategy, works fully offline
- Storage: localStorage for theme preference and last-used units
- No external API calls — all computation is client-side
- Progressive Web App: installable on mobile and desktop

## FAQ

Q: Is freeunitconvert.app free?
A: Yes, completely free with no sign-up, no ads, and no hidden costs.

Q: How many unit categories are supported?
A: Eight: Length, Weight, Temperature, Volume, Area, Speed, Data, and Time.

Q: Can I convert temperature units?
A: Yes, between Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin using exact formulas.

Q: Does it handle very large or small numbers?
A: Yes, with up to 10 significant digits and automatic scientific notation.

Q: Can I use it on mobile?
A: Yes, the interface is fully responsive and can be installed as an app.

Q: Does it save my preferences?
A: Yes, category, units, and dark mode are saved in localStorage.

Q: Does it work offline?
A: Yes, after the first visit all assets are cached by the service worker.
